kind: Diagnostic instrumented PXA simulator; one run under shared workstation load, not a controlled speed comparison or hardware timing
package: original-profile-v1; private timestamp probes, no shipping Host/ABI changes
raw_page: Official HTML/four external scripts unchanged; API/session/QR are synthetic non-account fixtures
findings: Compilation and execution both retain the scheduler for long turns.
50ms is an interrupt-handler deadline, not a preemptive bound; execution of the largest script exceeded it without invoking the handler in time.
These wall times include scheduling and diagnostic log overhead; they are not per-phase CPU or device measurements.
